regressions.claim: A cold-morning launch at -5 C ground temperature leaves the RunCam 5 box below its -10 C rating (only +0.454 K margin at the assumed default), so part_temperature fails.

A hot 38 C ground day changes the gas and air density and the box temperature, pushing the camera above its 40 C rating or the ascent rate out of the 4-6 m/s band, since the margins are only +0.45 K and +0.32 m/s.

The 4 h search window is the schema default, not the person's choice. A landing in a tree or on closed land that takes a two-day search (48 h) makes the always-on LightAPRS need about 0.21 W x 51 h, roughly 11 Wh, against 9.7 Wh from 3x L91 at -10 C, so power_margin fails.

With a 72 h search window (inside Wright's allowance; the 4 h value is an agent-chosen schema default), the always-on LoRa bus needs about 0.49 W x 75 h = 37 Wh against 26.0 Wh from 4S2P L91 at -10 C, so power_margin fails.

The launch site was an agent convention; at a 3000 m ground elevation the thinner air raises the touchdown descent rate under the spherachute-72 from 4.42 m/s to about 5.1 m/s, so landing_speed fails.

input.task: Two regression cases fail on the current design (totex-3000, spherachute-72, 140x110x110 mm inner XPS box, camera L91 4S2P, APRS L91 3S2P, LoRa L91 4S2P): (1) power_margin@balloon-1792886331-r2-1 (72 h recovery window): LoRa L91 4S2P needs 36.9 Wh, has 26.0 Wh at -10 C cell -> -10.9 Wh. (2) landing_speed@balloon-1792886331-r2-2 (launch elevation 3000 m): 5.12 m/s at 3000 m with 2390 g under the chute, limit 5.0 (-0.115 m/s). Constraints already learned: spherachute-96 (+227 g) fails ascent_rate, part_temperature, launch_window and imaging; a 3P LoRa string passes 72 h power but fails payload_fit in the current box; a 150 mm tall box cooled the camera to -13 C and failed part_temperature (margin now only +0.122 K, must stay >0 at -10 and 35 C ground); lipo-4s-6000 is 575 g. Round-1 design at 2268 g descent mass passed landing_speed@3000 m by +0.017 m/s, so descent mass must drop ~120 g or more, or the chute must grow without the mass penalty. Ideas to evaluate: a smaller/lighter balloon (burst margin is +7.8 km, so e.g. totex-2000/1600 could shed balloon remnant mass), a lower-power secondary radio/GPS so 4S2P suffices for 72 h, fewer camera cells (camera is off at burst), or restructuring buses.
